pluginSecurity.title: Plugin security
pluginSecurity.description: Restricted mode stops executable plugins and blocks Node, WASM and plugin host API calls. You can still install or remove packages and apply theme colors. This disables plugin execution; it is not an operating-system sandbox.
pluginSecurity.cliLocked: Restricted mode was enabled with --safe-mode or --restricted-mode. Restart without that argument to enable executable plugins.
pluginSecurity.blocked: Plugin execution is disabled in restricted mode. Open Settings → Plugins to review it.
pluginSecurity.unavailable: Plugin security settings could not be verified. Execution remains blocked.
pluginSecurity.approvalRequired: This plugin needs your approval before running. Start it or refresh its view to review permissions.
pluginSecurity.permissionDenied: This plugin has not been granted the requested host capability.
pluginSecurity.grantLimit: Too many saved plugin approvals. Revoke an unused approval and retry.
pluginSecurity.packageInvalid: The plugin package cannot be safely fingerprinted. Reinstall it from a trusted archive.
pluginSecurity.cliReason: Restricted mode was enabled by a startup argument.
pluginSecurity.recoveryReason: Restricted mode was enabled after an unexpected shutdown.
pluginSecurity.changed: The plugin or its authorization changed. Review its permissions and try again.
pluginSecurity.allowBody: {{name}} {{version}} requests permission to execute and use the following host capabilities:
pluginSecurity.noPermissions: No plugin host API permissions requested. Executable code still requires your approval.
pluginSecurity.nodeWarning: Node plugins are ordinary processes running as your operating-system user. Host API permissions do not sandbox Node: plugin code can also use Node's own filesystem, network and process APIs. Run code only from publishers you trust.
pluginSecurity.wasmWarning: WASM host capabilities are limited by the permissions below. Only approve capabilities you intend to give this plugin.
pluginSecurity.updateWarning: Approval applies to this installed package. Changed package content or newly requested permissions require approval again.
pluginSecurity.noGrants: No executable plugins have been approved.
pluginSecurity.recoveryHint: The previous session did not shut down cleanly. If a plugin caused the problem, enter restricted mode before running plugins again. You can dismiss this suggestion.
pluginSecurity.protectedStartup: The previous session ended unexpectedly. Tunnelde started in restricted mode to keep executable plugins stopped. Theme colors remain available. Review your plugins before choosing to leave restricted mode in Settings.
pluginSecurity.failureHint: A plugin reported an execution error. You can enter restricted mode to stop executable plugins while investigating.
